profile.name: noyla
profile.intro: I'm an Italian student who's curious about every layer of computer science. I focus on front-end development while exploring back-end systems, data and everything in between.
profile.workflow: I build small, useful products that solve real problems. I care about readable code, thoughtful interfaces and learning something new with every release. I use AI tools to enhance my workflow and improve my productivity, but I always make sure to understand the underlying concepts and not rely solely on them.

projects.title: Silicon Lab
projects.description: A web application for comparing laptops and other products based on your needs, with custom use cases and product lists.

projects.title: Zenit
projects.description: A web application for managing classes and students entirely in local storage. It allows for a complete school management experience, including grades and other functionalities. This is one of my first projects.
